name: Creative
description: A gallery-void portfolio for artists and creative pros — your work arranged in an interactive 3D spiral cone, with full-screen zoom and per-project detail pages. Dark canvas, single lime accent, Geist type.
designNotes: The Creative template is a dark gallery void built around an interactive 3D spiral cone of the artist's work — drag to rotate, with cursor-tilt and scroll parallax. A single lime accent (#DFFF00) over near-black, Geist + Geist Mono type, and Studio-Dialect-style bracket UI and plus-shape crosshairs. Each project links to its own detail page with a full-screen zoom lightbox (wheel / +- / drag-pan) and plus-shape prev/next navigation. Mirrors the 'My Eye Brain' live demo 1:1.
